newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won slides on dlr demand by importers.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won slides on dlr demand by importers.

text.p: The won closed lower against the dollar on Monday as demand for U.S. dollars by importers continued to weigh on the market, dealers said.
The won closed at 827.60 after opening at a high of 826.00. It touched a low of 828.30.
"Importer settlements were more than expected, estimated at $300 million," said Kim Jin-kyu, dealer at Citibank.

Dealers said the dollar's strength against the yen also boosted the dollar on the Seoul market. "But profit-taking emerged in the afternoon when the dollar fell to 111.40 yen from a high of 111.90 in other markets," he said.
